goal: Generate a 1:1 rounded square main image for social media profile pictures, podcasts, or developer community displays, featuring a cat-like 3D character reminiscent of Mark Zuckerberg, without any readable name text.

character.subject: Round-faced gray short-haired cat with slightly curled tufts on the head, small round glasses without logo
character.expression: Squinting with a light smile + one side of the mouth uplifted
character.pose: 胸像正面微侧、右手抱一台简化无标平板
outfit_or_accessory: Navy blue round-neck thin sweatshirt without any branding
A semi-transparent blue line frame floating above the head with a small polyhedral halo (Metaverse hint, non-brand logo).

style.rendering: 3D Pixar style + slight toon shading, clean edge lighting
style.color_palette: Cool gray + navy blue + cream white, accented with tech blue
style.lighting: Soft light + slight backlight to outline the shape.

background.type: Low saturation cyan-gray radial gradient + very light dots, not noisy

format.composition_safety: The subject occupies about 60% of the area, with 10% empty space on each side

must_keep: Q Cute, Single Subject, Main Color Within Three
avoid: Realistic human skin, recognizable human facial features
Include Facebook blue and white text or real logo
